history.summary: A modern Hindu temple dedicated to Shyam Baba (Khatu Shyam) on Mandalia Road, Chandan Nagar, Nirankari Colony, Khetrajpur, Sambalpur. Described in local listings as a large, recently-built temple with services such as poojas, anadhanam, aarti and festival celebrations. A YouTube video dated 18 April 2026 shows its 9th Pratishtha Divas Utsav, suggesting consecration around 2017 — UNVERIFIED, treat the date as provisional.

name: Anokha Shree Shyam Bihari Mandir
town_description: Sambalpur is a major city in western Odisha on the banks of the Mahanadi River and the administrative headquarters of Sambalpur district. It is known as the cultural capital of Western Odisha, famous for Sambalpuri (Bandha) ikat textiles, the Maa Samaleswari Temple, and the nearby Hirakud Dam, one of the world's longest earthen dams. The city is a commercial and railway hub connecting western Odisha to the rest of the state.
